fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form * 2. Proof of Non-Criminal Record * 3. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from whom can attest to the quality of the applicant’s academic performance and scholastic potential. The letters must include recommenders’ phone number and email address.If the letters cannot be uploaded by the applicant, the applicant can send the link in the system to the recommender for filling in the letter. 4. Other materials Applicants may submit additional documents which may demonstrate comprehensive abilities along with the required documents, such as award certificates o rpublished papers. * 5. English proficiency test certificate Original or notarized copyof TOEFL (IBT) score of 90 or above or IELTS (Academic) score 6.5 or above or Duolingo score of 110 or above or PTE Academic score of 61 or above, taken within two years prior to application date (only for applicants from non-English speaking countries), students from high school with major courses taught in English maybe waiveredof TOEFLor IELTS requirements. * 6. High School Full Transcript Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English. * 7. High School Diploma Applicants in their final year of high school study shall provide the expected graduation certificate(Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English). * 8. Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Only ordinary passports are accepted and the expiry date should be after March1, 2027. * 9. Passport-sized photos Three passport-sized photos (photo must have been taken within the past six months. * 10. Statement of personal financial capacity or financial support You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Basic Qualification: (1)Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. (2)High school graduate or above, with eligibility for university application. (3)Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. 2.Nationality Qualification: ★This requirement applies only to applicants who were born to parent(s)with Chinese citizenship at the time of birth. According to the<nationality law="" of="" the="" people's="" republic="" china="">and the relevant provisions issued by the Ministry of Education of China: (1)For applicants who were born in a foreig ncountry and have acquired foreign citizenship at birth. The applicants' parent(Chinese-citizenside)must have had obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants' birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/HongKong/Macao/Taiwan)for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April30, 2026(calculated in cycles from May1 to April30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2)For applicants who have emigrated from China and have acquired foreign citizenship. The applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2022, and completed formalities for renouncing the Chinese citizenship. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan)for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026(calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exits tamps). 3.Original or notarized copy of following English language test result(only for applicants whose native language is not English), students from high school with major courses taught in English may be waivered of the English language test. 4. Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment（CSCA）This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Council on behalf of the Ministry of Education of China. Students must take the assessment in advanceand get the score report. Students may check the time and content of the assessment on the official website(www.csca.cn) in early October 2025. Mandatory Assessment Subject : Maths(conducted in English). Note: For Phase 1 application, we accept the CSCA assessment result from December 2025, while for Phase 2 application, we accept the CSCA assessment result from both December 2025 and January 2026.
